{{Quote|Master Jedi, our records are very thorough. They cover eighty percent of the galaxy. If I can't tell you where it came from, nobody can.|An [[SP-4 analysis droid/Legends|SP-4]] analysis droid to Jedi Knight [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] regarding the origin of an [[Mk I Saberdart/Legends|unusual weapon]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref>}}
The '''Analysis Rooms''' was a series of chambers located in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="AOTC" /> Like the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]], operation of the Analysis Rooms was overseen by the [[Council of First Knowledge/Legends|Council of First Knowledge]].<ref name="The Clone Wars Campaign Guide">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|I wonder why it didn't show up in the analysis archives.|Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
[[File:Dk_archive.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A map of the Jedi Archives, detailing the location of the analysis wing and the equipment used there]]

Constructed during one of the Jedi Temple's numerous expansions, the Analysis Rooms was built to complement the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]], using [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and high technology to identify symbols, cultural influences, and other identifiers on objects more quickly than could be done through research in the Archives. Staffed exclusively by [[SP-4 analysis droid/Legends|SP-4]] and [[JN-66 analysis droid/Legends|JN-66 analysis droids]], the chambers in the wing were sealed off to organics; the highly sensitive equipment would be affected by living operators.<ref name="AOTC" />

The Analysis Rooms was available to any Jedi for use, helping Jedi research for missions or identify unknown suspects in a crime. On the eve of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was investigating the weapon used to kill [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] would-be assassin, [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]]. Turning to the Temple's analysis wing, Kenobi hoped that the droids would be able to trace the unique edges of the [[Mk I Saberdart/Legends|weapon]] to a known culture or planet. However, the droids rendered no results, suggesting that the dart was unique and handcrafted. Unsatisfied, Kenobi traveled to the [[CoCo Town/Legends|Collective Commerce District]] of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] where his friend [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] ran a small [[Dex's Diner/Legends|diner]]. Consulting the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]], Kenobi trusted the old prospector when he stated that the dart originated on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], a world located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. This led Kenobi to discover that all information on the planet had been deleted from the Archives, revealing why the droids in the analysis wing could not identify it.<ref name="AOTC" />

At the conclusion of the Clone Wars, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was discovered to be [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] Darth Sidious. Moving to destroy the Jedi Order, the Sith Lord sent his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to slaughter the Jedi in the Temple. With [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]] underway, Vader led the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] into the Temple and began to secure the building.<ref name="ROTS" /> Fighting through the Jedi, the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] secured the analysis wing, leaving it largely undamaged and still operational.<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>

After the Sith had gathered all the information needed from the wing, the rooms fell into disuse, lying vacant until the expulsion of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] from Coruscant. When the [[New Jedi Order]], under the leadership of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] secured the Temple, they began to search the ruins for any shread of teachings from the lost Order. With [[Tionne Solusar]] working to restore the Archives, the analysis room may have been searched and restored.<ref name="RS">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron]]''</ref> However, the restoration of the Temple was not to be. The structure was ruined beyond repair during the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Coruscant]] to the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], leaving the analysis wing a in ruins.<ref name="SbS">''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]''</ref>

Following the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] and the retaking of Coruscant by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Cal Omas]] ordered the [[Reconstruction Authority]] to rebuild the Temple in accordance to the old blueprints salvaged from the Archives.<ref name="DNI">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref> In [[43 ABY]], Jedi Knight [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] accessed one of the wing's laboratories, where she dissected a [[Cleaning droid/Legends|cleaner droid]] that had been bugged by reporter [[Javis Tyrr]] in order to get footage from inside the Temple. During her investigations her Jedi [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|mother]] and her [[Han Solo/Legends|father]] marched into the laboratory and accused her of knowing of an impending attack on the Temple by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] under the orders of Chief of State [[Natasi Daala]]. Admitting that she had been warned by Head of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Jagged Fel]], she defended her actions and told her fellow Jedi to take the information to the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|High Council]].<ref name="FOTJA" />

==Layout==
Located two stories below the main hall of the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] on level [[Aurek 5]], the analysis wing consisted of several laboratories,<ref name="FOTJA" /> analysis chambers, and research booths. The sterile analysis chambers hosted state-of-the-art polysensitive graspers and multispectral readers capable of detecting symbols, odor, and skin deposits on any subject. In order to keep a completely sterile environment, the analysis chambers were completely shut off to organics; Jedi would access a booth divided by a [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] barrier and place subjects on a tray that would transport the subject through the barrier for study.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the pre-vis for [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed|''The Force Unleashed'']], the template character, resembling [[Maris Brood]], uses [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to repel [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in this room, along with its equipment.
